fields.description: How long a node may fail its readiness probe, or hold no active lease, before it counts against the cluster. Shorter than this is a blip.
fields.label: Node Offline Seconds

fields.description: The cluster is Degraded once the certificate it serves on its hostname expires within this many days. ACME renews at 30.
fields.label: Certificate Warn Days

fields.description: Timeout for each readiness probe and the registry read. Health runs every minute, so a hung node must not still be waiting when the next tick starts.
fields.label: Read Timeout Seconds

fields.description: How long readings are kept in logs/mail_health.json.log, the local copy for when datum was unreachable. Nothing queries it.
fields.label: History Hours
